observation.command: cd /workspace/project && echo "=== string terkait project/qualif di bundle ==="; grep -oiE '"/[a-z0-9/_-]*(project|qualif|task|apply|annotat)[a-z0-9/_-]*"' /tmp/cl.js | sort -u | head -25; echo; echo "=== pola api/v1 lengkap ==="; grep -oE '\$\{[a-zA-Z_]+\}/v1/[a-z0-9/_${}.-]+' /tmp/cl.js | sort -u | head -15; echo; echo "=== literal api/v1/... ==="; grep -oE 'v1/[a-zA-Z0-9/_{}$.-]{3,40}' /tmp/cl.js | sort -u | head -40
